representation_primary: V1 area means; calendar columns keep their names
mapping: For a native variable x use mean__x; calendar names unchanged
notes: M is circulation and moisture, not a validated monsoon index.
C is regional SST only, not a complete ENSO/MJO climate group.
The spatial additions S0/S7 may only use source variables present in E0/E7 respectively.
Three terrain-wind-moisture proxies require all their inputs and belong only to S7.
Q is shifted by four hours for a retrospective sensitivity, not asserted equivalent to NRT.
